effects.effect: Your movement no longer provokes [opportunity attacks](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/opportunity-attack). Additionally, you can use your [Harlequin Gambit](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-5/harlequin-gambit) feature as a free [triggered action](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) when a creature is reduced to 0 [Stamina](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) by your [Clever Trick](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.shadow.level-1/clever-trick) ability.
